concepts.title: Chirping Smoke Detector
concepts.gag: Homie swats the chirping detector with a broom at 3am, it lands in the sink
concepts.stat: About 3 out of 5 home fire deaths happen in homes with no or non-working smoke alarm (NFPA)
fix: Twist it off, swap the battery
Hold the test button until it screams
Check the date on the back, replace the unit at 10 years

concepts.title: Frozen Pipes
concepts.gag: Homie aims a blowtorch at a frozen pipe under the sink, cabinet starts smoking
concepts.stat: Uninsulated pipes start freezing around 20 F outside (Building Research Council, U of Illinois)
fix: Shut off the main water valve
Open the faucet so melting water can escape
Warm with a hair dryer or hot towels, never a flame; burst pipe = call a plumber

concepts.title: Dirty Furnace Filter
concepts.gag: Homie vacuums the old filter, gets a face full of dust, jams it back in backwards
concepts.stat: Clogged filter raises heating/cooling energy use 5 to 15 percent (U.S. DOE)
fix: Find the filter, read the size and arrow
Slide the new one in, arrow toward the furnace
Write the date on the frame, swap every 1 to 3 months

concepts.title: Overflowing Gutters
concepts.gag: Homie leaf-blows the clogged gutter from a wobbly ladder, wet mess lands on him
concepts.stat: About 1 in 60 insured homes files a water damage or freezing claim each year (III)
fix: Steady ladder and a scoop, bag the gunk
Flush the downspout with a hose until clear
Extend the downspout 4 to 6 feet from the foundation; look at gutter guards if you clean every month

concepts.title: Stuck in a Solar Contract
concepts.gag: Homie opens the mail and gets buried under two bills: the solar payment and the electric bill he thought was gone
concepts.stat: Door-to-door sales come with a 3 business day right to cancel (FTC Cooling-Off Rule)
fix: Find the contract, check if it is a lease, a PPA or a loan
Read the cancellation and transfer clauses
Write down what was promised vs what you got; have the contract reviewed before paying anyone

concepts.title: The Timeshare Bill That Never Stops
concepts.gag: Homie gets a maintenance fee bill for a week he never used; the paper unrolls across the living room
concepts.stat: Average maintenance fee $1,480 a year per interval (ARDA 2025 study)
fix: Check if you are still inside the cancellation window (short, set by state law)
Call the resort and ask about an exit or deed-back program
Avoid anyone who wants a big upfront fee and guarantees a result

concepts.title: Burst Pipe: Is It Covered?
concepts.gag: Homie plugs a spraying burst pipe with chewing gum and it rockets across the basement
concepts.stat: Water damage and freezing claims average about $15,400 (III, 2019 to 2023)
fix: Shut off the main water valve
Photograph everything before you clean up
Read your policy: a sudden burst is usually covered, a slow leak or a flood usually is not; then call your insurer

concepts.title: Leaving Town for Thanksgiving
concepts.gag: Homie tapes a GONE TILL SUNDAY sign on the front door and posts road trip selfies while packages pile up on the porch
concepts.stat: The average burglary costs the victim about $2,661 (FBI, 2019)
fix: Put lights on timers and hold your mail and deliveries
Post the trip photos after you get home
Lock every door and window and ask a neighbor to check in

concepts.title: Behind on House Payments
concepts.gag: Homie hides the mortgage letters in the freezer, the freezer door will not close
concepts.stat: In most cases a servicer cannot start foreclosure until you are more than 120 days behind (CFPB rule)
fix: Open the mail and call your servicer early
Ask what options exist: forbearance, a repayment plan, a modification, or selling before it gets to foreclosure
Talk to a free HUD-approved housing counselor before you sign anything

concepts.title: Oven Dies Before Thanksgiving
concepts.gag: The oven dies with the turkey inside and Homie tries to finish it with a hair dryer
concepts.stat: An electric range lasts about 13 years, a gas range about 15 (NAHB)
fix: Check the easy stuff first: clock set, door lock off, plugged in
Find your manufacturer or home warranty and read what is covered and the service fee
Book the repair before the holiday rush and get the repair vs replace quote in writing

concepts.title: Turkey Grease Down the Drain
concepts.gag: Homie pours a whole pan of hot turkey grease into the sink and the drain burps it back up at him
concepts.stat: Grease is one of the leading causes of sewer blockages and backups (EPA)
fix: Let the grease cool, pour it into a can and toss it in the trash
Wipe pans with a paper towel before washing
Slow drain: hot water and dish soap, then a plunger, never mix chemical cleaners

concepts.title: Inheriting the Family House
concepts.gag: At the family dinner everyone grabs the house deed, Homie wins the tug of war and rips it in half
concepts.stat: Only 46 percent of US adults have a will (Gallup, 2021)
fix: Find out if there is a will or trust and who the executor is
Keep the house locked, insured and the bills paid while it sits empty
Get a value estimate and talk to a probate attorney before selling

concepts.title: Ice Dams
concepts.gag: Homie hacks at the ice on the gutter with a hammer from a ladder and the whole gutter rips off
concepts.stat: Ice dams form when the upper roof is above 32 F while the edge stays below freezing (University of Minnesota Extension)
fix: From the ground, pull snow off the roof edge with a roof rake
Keep gutters and downspouts clear before the freeze
Water stains on the ceiling: call a roofer and have the attic insulation and ventilation checked
